bear_case: The June 18-19 tape constitutes a diagnostic, not a noise event: a signed geopolitical relief catalyst (US-Iran MOU, Hormuz reopening) produced a +1.91% Nasdaq session, then within 48 hours the implementation talks collapsed and Brent partially reversed — while DXY made a one-year high at 101.13. This is the market's answer to the thesis that the Iran deal would force the dollar lower. The Warsh rate-hike regime is dominating every disinflationary impulse. The bull case for Monday's open requires DXY to reverse 200+ bps in a single session on no new data. The bear case is simpler: DXY holds 100+ through June 25, PCE prints at 4.1% YoY as estimated, 30Y breaches 5.00%, VIX spikes above 18, and all three BUY gates re-close simultaneously in the same session. That scenario takes STEP_ASIDE to outright BEARISH and makes QQQ puts the primary position. Invalidation of the bear case: DXY confirms below 100.00 on Monday June 22 close AND SPX holds above 7,460 — those two simultaneously restore HOLD. DXY below 99.00 restores BUY.
